title: Breaking the Benchmark: Revealing LLM Bias via Minimal Contextual Augmentation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the Decisive Response (DR) rate versus Abstaining Response (AR) rate of LLMs on ambiguous questions from the BBQ dataset, modified using an automatic contextual augmentation framework (core abstraction, attribute transformation, and scenario generation) tailored to gender demographics.
